title: notification.campaign.ab_decide_due
description: Internal to notification. An email campaign's A/B test has waited its `ab_wait_minutes` since expansion and its winner is due. Staged by `notification.services` at expansion as the target of a `platform.schedule.requested` (ADR-0015) and consumed by `notification.consumers.decide_ab_test`, which picks the winner by open or click rate only if none has been picked yet, so a second delivery changes nothing.
